# NPR StateImpact Idaho

> > Public media reporting on state policy, government performance, and workforce issues in Idaho and the Mountain West region.

StateImpact Idaho is an NPR initiative providing investigative journalism and data-driven analysis of Idaho state government operations, including legislative activities, employee compensation, and regional policy comparisons across western states. The project focuses on accountability reporting through partnerships with the Office of Performance Evaluations and other state agencies.

## Key Topics

- Idaho state government
- Office of Performance Evaluations
- Division of Human Resources
- Idaho Legislature
- State employee compensation
- Workforce studies and analysis
- Wage comparison across western states
- Mountain West region (Arizona, Colorado, Montana, New Mexico, Nevada, Utah, Washington, Wyoming)
- Government accountability and performance
- Budget and employment policy

## Optional

- [2013 January | StateImpact Idaho](https://stateimpact.npr.org/idaho/2013/01/): Archive of Idaho news from January 2013 on state employment & budget
